Tests that parentElement() does not crash when an accessibility object is detached during the update it triggers. crbug.com/398049426

PASS axObject.role is 'AXRole: AXStaticText'

PASS axObject.isValid is true
PASS parent == null || parent.isValid is true
PASS successfullyParsed is true
